cues.headline: What a pass!
cues.body: Ander Lindqvist just played the hardest pass of the match so far.

cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Emil Lindqvist just flew past at 26 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: GOAL! Goran Dunmore!
cues.body: Ashvale Town score! It's Harbor City 0–1 Ashvale Town.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town have switched it up
cues.body: New shape for Ashvale Town on the ball: a 3-2-5 now, after a 4-3-3.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town are on top
cues.body: Ashvale Town are on top: winning the ball back in the opposition half 3 times, playing 9 progressive passes and forcing Harbor City into 3 losses in their own half in the last 5 minutes. Ashvale Town are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: A tactical tweak from Harbor City
cues.body: Harbor City look different on the ball: a 4-3-3 now, where they were a 4-1-2-3.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town are sitting back
cues.body: Ashvale Town have dropped off: their defence now stands 23 m from goal, where it was 42 m. Risky for Ashvale Town while they're protecting a lead.

cues.headline: Harbor City have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Harbor City's way: leaving Ashvale Town just 2.0 passes per defensive action, closing Ashvale Town down 7 times and recovering the ball 4 times in the final third in the last 5 minutes. Just what Harbor City need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Niko Dravic is the hub
cues.body: Ashvale Town keep finding Niko Dravic: he is on the end of 58% of their passes in the last 10 minutes.

cues.headline: Dario Underhill is the hub
cues.body: Harbor City keep finding Dario Underhill: he is on the end of 60% of their passes in the last 10 minutes.

cues.headline: Oren Isard scores!
cues.body: Get in! Harbor City 0–2 Ashvale Town. Against the run of play: Harbor City were in control.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town have switched it up
cues.body: New shape for Ashvale Town on the ball: a 3-2-5 now, after a 4-3-3.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town are on top
cues.body: Ashvale Town have taken over: they've had the ball 77% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Ashvale Town are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: A tactical tweak from Harbor City
cues.body: Harbor City look different on the ball: a 4-3-3 now, where they were a 3-2-5.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 6.4 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Harbor City keep losing it at the back
cues.body: Harbor City have given the ball away 7 times in their own half in the last 5 minutes. Dangerous!

cues.headline: It's in! Emil Underhill!
cues.body: Emil Underhill finds the net for Harbor City: Harbor City 1–2 Ashvale Town. The broken game finally produced a goal. It came 5 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: What a ball from Fenn Valcourt!
cues.body: One pass, 4 Ashvale Town players taken out. That's how you open a defence.

cues.headline: GOAL! Fenn Valcourt!
cues.body: Harbor City score! It's Harbor City 2–2 Ashvale Town.

cues.headline: Tired legs at Harbor City
cues.body: Harbor City are slowing down: 52 m a minute per player lately, from 72 m earlier on. With the score level, Ashvale Town will smell a chance.

cues.headline: Fenn Valcourt scores!
cues.body: Get in! Harbor City 3–2 Ashvale Town.

cues.headline: Tired legs at Ashvale Town
cues.body: Ashvale Town are slowing down: 63 m a minute per player lately, from 85 m earlier on.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Harbor City 56%, Ashvale Town 44%. Neither team on top.

recap.headline: Full time: Harbor City 3–2 Ashvale Town
recap.summary: A deserved win for Harbor City.
